messages:
rohit: Quick sync — aiming to roll at 10:00 UTC. Draft release notes are in the shared doc (see link below). Need a short internal blurb + emergency rollback plan.

maya: On it. I'll trim the user-facing bullets and add the config flag note.

liz: Can we highlight the small schema change in the RN? ops will need to know the DB migration window.

rohit: Yes — add a bold line about the migration window (10:05–10:20 UTC) and the fallback toggle.

jamie-oncall: I'll be oncall for the window. If errors spike, I want an explicit rollback trigger: >5% 5xx in 5m.

eric: Agreed. Suggest we keep canary at 5% for first 15m, then 50% if healthy. Add the metrics dashboard link.

maya: Draft internal blurb proposed: "Heads-up: rolling service X with minor schema change and config toggle. Migration 10:05–10:20 UTC. Oncall: @jamie-oncall. Rollback criteria: >5% 5xx in 5m." Thoughts? :thinking_face:

liz: LGTM, please also call out expected user impact (short reads may return stale results for ~1–2 min).

rohit: Good call. Add that. Also note the deploy-bot job name: `deploy/service-x/2026-03-22`.

deploy-bot: Deploy job scheduled by rohit: deploy/service-x/2026-03-22 at 10:00 UTC. Canaries: 5% -> 50%.

eric: For rollback commands, put this exact snippet in the RN ops section:
```
# rollback to previous stable
/deploy rollback deploy/service-x@stable
```

jamie-oncall: Copy. I'll watch the error rate and take action if it crosses the threshold.

maya: I'll post the internal announcement 5m before start in #general and tag growth/product. Draft below for approval: "Starting service X rollout at 10:00 UTC. Minimal user-facing impact expected. Oncall: @jamie-oncall. See internal RN for details and rollback plan."

liz: Approve. Add a link to the incident dashboard and the RN doc.

rohit: Final checklist: 1) RN doc updated (maya) 2) Announcement prepped (maya) 3) Oncall ready (jamie-oncall) 4) Deploy scheduled (deploy-bot) 5) Rollback snippet in RN (eric). If anyone wants to add last minute notes, drop here. :thumbsup:

maya: Done — RN updated, announcement queued.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deployment will start in 10 minutes. Use `/deploy cancel deploy/service-x/2026-03-22` to cancel.

jamie-oncall: Standing by.

rohit: Thanks — team green.
